quotes.text: People forget I nearly quit at nineteen. Not because I wasn't good enough — I thought I was good enough, maybe too much — but because I looked at the life and I wasn't sure I wanted it. You give up a lot of normal. I had a coach sit me down in a café in Lyon and basically talk me back into it over two hours and a plate of food I couldn't finish because I was so nervous. I think about him every time things get hard.

quotes.context: High Performance podcast with Jake Humphrey and Damian Hughes, Episode 214, released February 2023

quotes.text: I've seen riders go into a mountain stage with a plan so detailed it covered every kilometer, every watt, every gel — and then a crosswind hits at the base and the whole thing is worthless. So I stopped making detailed plans. I make a disposition, I suppose you'd call it. A feeling for how I want to race, and then I just race.
